This Criminal Original Petition is filed to call for the records relating to impugned Charge Sheet in PRC.No.274 of 2023 pending on the file of the Learned Judicial Magistrate No.V, Tirunelveli and quash the same in so far as the Petitioners are concern.

2. The contention of the petitioners is that based on the complaint lodged by the 2nd respondent,
the 1st respondent registered the First Information Report in Crime No.15 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 375(a), 376 and 506(i) of IPC against the petitioners.

entities.text: First Information Report in Crime No.15 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. The further contention of the petitioners is that they compromised the issue with the 2nd respondent amicably.
A joint memo of compromise was filed, which has been duly signed by the p e t i t i o n e r s a n d t h e 2 n d r e s p o n d e n t a n d a l s o b y t h e i r r e s p e c t i v e c o u n s e l s .
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD).No.21039 of 2023 4.
The petitioners and the 2nd respondent appeared before this Court along with their counsels and also produced their Aadhar cards.
They were also identified by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor and the Investigation Officer.
Both the parties were enquired by me and they accepted the terms of compromise.
Hence, the Compromise Memo is recorded.
5. Eventhough, the complaint has been registered under Section 376 of IPC, it is informed to this Court that it is a love affair between the victim girl and the first accused.

Marriage arrangements were made by the parents of the first accused with the defacto complainant who is the victim, the father of the victim girl has some objection over the process of arrangements of the marriage.
Hence a complaint was given by the second respondent herein and a case was registered.
She further submitted that the complaint was given by her at the instigation of her parents.
Now she voluntarily left her parental home and came to the house of the first accused and they are living peacefully for the past four months.
The parents of the first accused who are the other accused persons, undertook to take care of the victim girl. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD).No.21039 of 2023 6.

Considering the totality of the circumstances, the nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioners and also in view of the joint compromise memo, dated 27.11.2023, this Court is of the opinion that no useful purpose will be served by keeping the matter pending.

Hence, all further proceedings in PRC.No.274 of 2023 pending on the file of the Learned Judicial Magistrate No.V,
Tirunelveli, is quashed and the compromise memo is recorded.
